_about: AiHub settings shared by every machine. Put this machine's own values in hub/settings.local.json (git-ignored); it is laid over this file.
_models_dir: The folder holding every AI model, one folder inside it per kind (each tool's models below). Relative to this project's folder, or a full path (~ allowed). Each tool is told its own folder when it starts.
_safety_models: The folder inside models_dir holding the nudity checkers, shared by every tool that checks pictures or videos. Each tool is told where it is when it starts.
_apps: The tiles, in order. folder: the tool's folder (with its own start.py and .venv). port: where it runs on this computer only (the hub passes its pages through). models: its folder inside models_dir. about: the line on the tile. tile: false = no tile (a helper the hub starts itself).

apps.name: Image AI
apps.about: Pictures from a prompt, themes, library

apps.name: Code AI
apps.about: Ask the local models, bulk jobs, pipelines

apps.about: Sound effects from a prompt, with a WAV library

apps.name: Talk
apps.about: Talk with your local AI: it listens, answers out loud and does things

_autostart: Tools started with the hub (by id), on this machine: Talk adds itself while Always listening is on.
_start_seconds: How long a tool may take to start before the hub gives up.
